<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 360" width="500" height="360">
  <!-- White Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Graph axes -->
  <!-- t-axis (horizontal) -->
  <line x1="60" y1="200" x2="450" y2="200" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="450,195 460,200 450,205" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- v-axis (vertical) -->
  <line x1="120" y1="40" x2="120" y2="310" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="115,40 120,30 125,40" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- Axis Labels -->
  <text x="455" y="222" font-family="Times New Roman" font-style="italic" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">t / s</text>
  <text x="110" y="35" font-family="Times New Roman" font-style="italic" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">v / m s</text>
  <text x="126" y="30" font-family="Times New Roman" font-size="10">-1</text> <!-- superscript for -1 -->

  <!-- Origin / Tick labels -->
  <text x="105" y="204" font-family="Times New Roman" font-size="12" text-anchor="end">0</text>
  <text x="110" y="85" font-family="Times New Roman" font-size="12" text-anchor="end">6.0</text>
  <line x1="116" y1="80" x2="124" y2="80" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="110" y="304" font-family="Times New Roman" font-size="12" text-anchor="end">-6.0</text>
  <line x1="116" y1="300" x2="124" y2="300" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- Velocity-Time Graph Line -->
  <!-- Segment 1: free fall from 0 to X (v goes from 0 to 6.0) -->
  <line x1="120" y1="200" x2="220" y2="80" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Segment 2: contact with trampoline X to Y (curve from v=6.0 to v=-6.0) -->
  <path d="M 220,80 Q 250,220 280,300" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Segment 3: Y to Z (straight line from v=-6.0 at t_Y to v=0 at t_Z) -->
  <line x1="280" y1="300" x2="380" y2="200" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Points on Graph -->
  <!-- Point X at (220, 80) -->
  <circle cx="220" cy="80" r="3" fill="#000000" />
  <text x="220" y="68" font-family="Times New Roman" font-style="italic" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">X</text>

  <!-- Point Y at (280, 300) -->
  <circle cx="280" cy="300" r="3" fill="#000000" />
  <text x="280" y="322" font-family="Times New Roman" font-style="italic" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Y</text>

  <!-- Point Z at (380, 200) -->
  <circle cx="380" cy="200" r="3" fill="#000000" />
  <text x="380" y="190" font-family="Times New Roman" font-style="italic" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Z</text>

  <!-- Dashed lines for clarity (optional, standard exam style usually just has points and axes) -->
  <line x1="280" y1="200" x2="280" y2="300" stroke="#666666" stroke-dasharray="3,3" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="380" y1="200" x2="380" y2="200" stroke="#666666" stroke-dasharray="3,3" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- Time value ticks -->
  <text x="280" y="214" font-family="Times New Roman" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">0.5</text>
  <line x1="280" y1="196" x2="280" y2="204" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <text x="380" y="214" font-family="Times New Roman" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">1.1</text>
  <line x1="380" y1="196" x2="380" y2="204" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="250" y="345" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 1.1</text>
</svg>
